description:
Create a file at the relative path `report/total.txt` inside the current project/workspace directory (create the `report` directory first if it does not exist).

The file must contain ONLY the sum of the numbers 17, 25 and 58 — i.e. the single integer result of 17 + 25 + 58. Compute it correctly (do the addition carefully). Write just the number followed by a single trailing newline, with no extra text, no labels, no equals sign, no explanation, no currency symbols, no spaces.

Then verify your work: read the file back and confirm its content is exactly the computed sum. Report back the exact bytes/content you wrote and the path you wrote it to. Do not create any other files.
